Why AI hasn't stuck yet

  • A chatbot nobody uses Generic tools that don't know your business or your data.
  • Too many options Every vendor says AI. None says where to start.
  • Fear of lock-in Handing your process to a tool you can't leave.
  • No one to build it Your team runs the business. Nobody has time to wire AI into it.

What we build

Built in accounts you own. The agent drafts, checks, or flags; a person makes the call.

  1. A map of your work Where the hours go, which tools are involved, and which jobs repeat.
  2. A short list, ranked The jobs where an agent would help, and the ones where it wouldn't, with the reasons.
  3. One built for real If one is worth it, we build it in your accounts, with a person approving what matters.

Tell us about your version of this

How it starts

  1. 01 A call about one task Tell us the job that eats your week and the tools it touches. We will say plainly whether it is worth building.
  2. 02 Build it in your accounts We set up the data and connections in accounts you own, starting with the tools that task needs.
  3. 03 Run it with a person in charge The agent drafts, checks, or flags. Someone on your team approves anything that matters.
  4. 04 Hand over You get the code, the documentation, and the access. Keep us on for support, or don't.
